label: ILLUSTRATIVE SAMPLE — NOT A CLIENT RECORD

severities.label: Critical
severities.definition: Potentially serious safety or property concern requiring prompt professional attention.

severities.label: Moderate
severities.definition: Noticeable defect affecting quality or functionality.

findings.title: Unfinished electrical outlet
findings.observation: Exposed conductors are visible at an unfinished outlet in this fictional example.
findings.recommendation: Do not use the point. Arrange prompt assessment and safe rectification by a qualified electrician.

findings.title: Hollow-sounding floor tiles
findings.observation: A cluster of tiles gives a hollow response during the example functional check.
findings.recommendation: Ask the builder to assess adhesion and arrange appropriate rectification.

findings.title: Moisture at the window reveal
findings.observation: Dampness indicators are noted at the wall-window junction in the illustrative scenario.
findings.recommendation: Investigate the source and agree rectification before repainting.

findings.title: Persistent water pooling
findings.observation: Water remains near an accessible drainage junction in this example.
findings.recommendation: Have the contractor review drainage and relevant surface details.

findings.title: Visible crack requiring assessment
findings.observation: A visible crack at a junction merits a closer professional review in this example.
findings.recommendation: Arrange appropriate professional assessment; do not infer structural adequacy from a visual inspection.

findings.title: Incomplete grout joints
findings.observation: Gaps are visible in selected grout joints.
findings.recommendation: Have the affected joints prepared and made good with a suitable material.

findings.title: Leakage at accessible connection
findings.observation: Moisture is visible at an accessible pipe connection in the example.
findings.recommendation: Have a competent plumber review the connection and verify the completed work.

findings.title: Incomplete sealant joint
findings.observation: Sealant continuity is incomplete at an accessible junction.
findings.recommendation: Agree appropriate preparation and resealing after checking the underlying condition.

findings.title: Visible sealing gaps
findings.observation: A localised gap is visible at the frame-to-wall seal.
findings.recommendation: Request inspection of the joint and a suitable sealing repair.

findings.title: Loose accessible fitting
findings.observation: A fitting shows movement during an accessible functional check.
findings.recommendation: Have the fixing checked and rectified by the appropriate contractor.

findings.title: Uneven tile alignment
findings.observation: A noticeable level difference is recorded between adjacent tiles.
findings.recommendation: Review the extent with the builder and agree appropriate correction.

findings.title: Patchy paint finish
findings.observation: Uneven paint coverage is visible under the example inspection lighting.
findings.recommendation: Prepare the surface and make good the finish.

findings.title: Minor surface scratches
findings.observation: Local cosmetic scratches are visible on an accessible finish.
findings.recommendation: Agree a suitable cosmetic repair and protect the finished surface.

findings.title: Stiff door latch
findings.observation: The latch operates with avoidable resistance in this illustrative example.
findings.recommendation: Adjust the fitting and verify smooth operation.
